name: The Queen Adelaide
summary: A bar on Hackney Road with draught beer and cider and a basement used for club nights. A listings site, ma.to, describes the basement as a space for queer culture and underground dance music.

music.notes: Frequent club nights in the basement, many of them queer-focused, according to ma.to.

evidence.quote: Draught beer and cider. Selection of wines and spirits.
Located in East London, The Queen Adelaide is a vital basement venue dedicated to queer culture, community connection, and underground dance music
Its basement space hosts frequent club nights soundtracked by Hi-NRG, Italo disco, electroclash, and house.
The Queen Adelaide hosts a variety of queer-focused club nights featuring genres like house, disco, and electroclash in its basement space.
